Some feedback:

- With https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/33505, we could color the Base64 text in gray as to take less attention (it's secondary information).
- I get an error when running `misc/scripts/retrace.py` with no arguments or one argument:

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/hugo/Documents/Git/godotengine/godot/misc/scripts/retrace.py", line 9, in <module>
    sym_code = sys.argv[2]
               ~~~~~~~~^^^
IndexError: list index out of range
```

I suggest making use of Python `argparse` (it's part of the standard library) for CLI argument validation and help generation.

- If the first argument of `misc/scripts/retrace.py` does not exist, I get this error:

```
================================================================
Load address: 0x5645b2fe5000
================================================================
1 0x7fc5e6d6afb0 ( libc.so.6 + 0x19fb0 ) - ???
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/hugo/Documents/Git/godotengine/godot/misc/scripts/retrace.py", line 115, in <module>
    demangled_symbols[i],
    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^
IndexError: list index out of range
```

It should print an error message stating that the binary can't be found instead.

- If I strip the binary from its debug symbols and use `retrace.py`, I get a backtrace with no information (as expected). It should probably print a warning at the top, stating that no debug symbols were found in the binary (or next to the binary), using a heuristic similar to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/55565:

```
WARNING: Couldn't symbolicate this backtrace, as the binary passed as a parameter to this script does not contain debug symbols, and no debug symbols were found next to it.
To resolve this, recompile the binary with the `debug_symbols=yes` SCons option.
```
